The '''''Lucky Lekku''''' was a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry]] that participated in various battles during the [[Clone Wars]]. In service of the [[Galactic Republic]], it would be utilized fighting against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. It was distinguished, the nose art of a [[Twi'lek]] pin-up model, who bore [[clone trooper armor]], emblazoned on both sides of the [[gunship]]'s fore-end. The ''Lucky Lekku'' had been further exemplified by the [[Defense of Cato Neimoidia|Battle of Cato Neimoidia]] in [[19 BBY]], since its crew had destroyed sixty-three [[Vulture-class starfighter|''Vulture''-class droid starfighters]] and twenty-six [[droid tri-fighter]]s, resulting in an amassed total of eighty-nine starfighters destroyed—these kills were tallied on the right-hand side of the gunship.<ref name="Sabotage Trivia Gallery">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/sabotage-trivia-gallery|text="Sabotage" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 6}}</ref>

==Characteristics==
A 17.69-[[meter]]-long, 17-meter-wide, and 6.9-meter-tall<ref name="Size" /> [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry]] [[gunship]], ''Lucky Lekku'' was propelled by twin [[engine]]s located on the rear of the [[hull]].<ref name="TCWfilm" /><ref name="Complete Vehicles">''[[Star Wars Complete Vehicles, New Edition]]''</ref> The gunship was armed with three antipersonnel turrets, two of which were mounted at its bow while a third was mounted at its aft, two dorsal mounted [[mass-driver missile launcher]]s along with one port and starboard [[composite-beam]] [[laser]] [[turret]].<ref name="Weapons" />

The ''Lucky Lekku''{{'s}} nose art depicted a Twi'lek [[Gender|woman]], wearing form-fitting clone armor, posessing [[lekku]] [[Color|colured]] blue and a shade of green, creating a blotchy pattern. Surrounding this art, laid the tallies for the confirmed [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[starfighter]]s destroyed.<ref name="Sabotage Trivia Gallery" />

==History==
===Overview===
The ''Lucky Lekku''<ref name="SOR Trivia Gallery">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/storm-over-ryloth-trivia-gallery|text="Storm over Ryloth" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 4}}</ref> had been in the active service of the [[Republic Navy|Galactic Republic Navy]], since the earliest engagements of the conflict, within [[22 BBY]], notably during the Battle of [[Teth]].<ref name="TCWfilm" /> The gunship was also stationed within the hanger of the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer]], ''[[Resolute]]'',<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" /> of [[Jedi General]], [[Anakin Skywalker]]'s [[fleet]], consisting of fellow Venators, ''[[Defender]]'' and ''[[Redeemer]]''.<ref name="SOR Episode Guide">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/storm-over-ryloth-episode-gallery|text="Storm Over Ryloth" Episode Gallery}} {{C|Slide 2}}</ref> The ''Lucky Lekku'' remained in service as late as the [[Defense of Cato Neimoidia|Battle]] of [[Cato Neimoidia]].<ref name="Sabotage">{{TCW|Sabotage (episode)}}</ref>

===Battle of Teth===
The ''Lucky Lekku'' was among a flight of seven other Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry vehicles, which launched an assault upon the abandoned [[B'omarr Order Monastery]], on [[Teth]], in an attempt to find [[Rotta]] the Hutt, the son of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], whom [[Asajj Ventress]], a [[Dark Acolyte|Sith acolyte]] of [[Dooku|Count Dooku]], had abducted from his [[homeworld]] [[Tatooine]].<ref name="TCWfilm" />

The gunship approached the monastery and had sustained [[Laser|heavy oncoming fire]] from several [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid]]s, that had been positioned on the Teth Monastery. The powerful [[laser cannon]]s mounted on the [[droid]]s were effective in repulsing the ''Lucky Lekku'', as well as the other gunships, attacking from above. Unable to land on the monastery, Anakin Skywalker, with his recently assigned [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano]], instructed for the [[Blast shield (gunship)|blast shields]] to be closed, and subsequently directed the transports and [[carrier]]s to deploy their ground forces to the [[jungle]] below. Traveling under the barrage being inflicted against them, the ''Lucky Lekku'' assisted in this deployment.<ref name="TCWfilm" /> Although it had endured heavy fire, the gunship survived this encounter and continued its participation within the war.<ref name="Rookies" /><ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" /><ref name="Point Rain" /><ref name="Sabotage" />

===Defense of the Rishi Station===
The ''Lucky Lekku'', along with another LAAT/i, known as the ''[[Crumb Bomber]]'',<ref name="SOM Trivia Gallery">{{SW|url=shadow-of-malevolence-trivia-gallery|text="Shadow of Malevolence" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 1}}</ref> aided in the search for surviving [[clone trooper]]s on the surface of the [[Rishi moon]].<ref name="Rookies" />

The gunship assisted in the location and retrieval of clone troopers [[Clone Marshal Commander]] [[Cody|CC-2224]] "Cody" and [[Clone Captain]] [[Rex|CT-7567]] "Rex," along with the surviving clones troopers of the [[Rishi Station unit]], [[Echo|CT-1409]] "Echo" and [[Fives|CT-5555]] "Fives."<ref name="Rookies" /> The two latter clones would be brought back to the fleet, and are commended directly by Jedi Generals Skywalker and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], for their valiant service, and admirable sacrifice - they are both awarded with medals and absorbed into the [[501st Legion]].<ref name="Rookies" /><ref name="Rookies Episode Gallery">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/rookies-episode-gallery|text="Rookies" Episode Gallery}} {{C|Slide 12}}</ref>

===Battle of Ryloth===
During the battle, ''Lucky Lekku''—along with ''[[Spaceward Ho!]]''—were stationed onboard the [[flagship]] of General Skywalker, ''Resolute'', which was the [[capital ship]] of his [[Skywalker's fleet|personal fleet]], in the Fifth Fleet, within the Open Circle Armada.<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" /><ref name="Resolute Affiliated Fleets" />

===Second Battle of Geonosis===
During this engagement, ''Lucky Lekku'' was utilized strictly as an armored infantry transport, carrying its passengers of clone troopers to the ground, for the objective of a planetary-wide assault—akin to it's fellow gunships.<ref name="Point Rain" /> The purpose of the invasion was to halt the operation of the many [[Geonosis droid factories|droid foundries]] across Geonosis, preventing the Confederacy of Independent Systems from further strengthening their [[Confederacy military|military]]—the most vital of them, the [[Geonosis primary droid foundry|primary droid foundry]], was protected by a [[deflector shield]] and constituted as the main target for the Republic landing forces.<ref name="Point Rain" /><ref name="LPR Episode Guide">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/landing-at-point-rain-episode-guide|text="Landing at Point Rain" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} {{C|Synopsis}}</ref>

The gunship was merely one of multitudes of LAAT/i [[repulsorcraft]] and [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/carrier|Low Altitude Assault Transport carriers]] used to attack the planet.<ref name="Point Rain" /> Within the [[atmosphere]], the landing forces encountered harsh [[Geonosian]] resistance, with significant [[Death|casualties]] being inflicted by the ground-based Geonosian defense emplacements<ref name="Point Rain" /><ref name="LPR Episode Gallery">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/landing-at-point-rain-episode-gallery|text="Landing at Point Rain" Episode Gallery}} {{C|Slide 4}}</ref> namely the [[LR1K sonic cannon]]s and [[J-1 proton cannon]]s. Starfighters were also employed, which were predominantly the [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter|''Nantex''-class territorial defense starfighters]].<ref name="Point Rain" /><ref name="LPR Episode Gallery" /> Despite the incurred loss of many [[Low Altitude Assault Transport]]s to overwhelming firepower, the ''Lucky Lekku'' survived and continued to partake in the Clone War.<ref name="Sabotage" />

===Battle of Cato Neimoidia===
The gunship was deployed as a transport amidst five other LAAT/i gunships, carrying Captain Rex to Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano's position after they had become stranded on the surface, upon the loss of their [[starfighters]] .<ref name="Sabotage" /> By this time, the ''Lucky Lekku'' had accumulated a total of eighty-nine destroyed fighters, as indicated by the recorded tally painted onto its side.<ref name="Sabotage" /><ref name="Sabotage Trivia Gallery" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Lucky Lekku'' first appeared, within the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]], albeit unidentified, until the publishing of [[The Clone Wars Episode Guides|The Clone Wars Episode Guide]] for "[[Storm Over Ryloth]]" on [[StarWars.com]], in which it was titled within the slide images of the Episode Gallery. The Concept Art Gallery for "[[Sabotage (episode)|Sabotage]]" has an illustration by Pat Presley; each indicates the crew of the ''Lucky Lekku'' has downed dozens of droid fighters throughout the conflict. Since its debut, it has had limited appearances, across the majority of the television series, from [[Season One]]'s ''Malevolence'' arc, to the beginning of [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|Season Five's]] final arc and finale, "Sabotage."

The stylized nose art which was adorned on both sides of the gunship, along with various other LAAT vehicles within the series, is a reference and homage to real-world pin-up art, usually depicting buxom and scantily clad models or actresses, that was painted onto fighter and bomber aircraft, by their crews, during the Second World War and beyond.<ref name="The Clone Wars Rewatch TCW film I">{{SW|url=news/the-clone-wars-rewatch-theatrical-release-2-of-3|text=''The Clone Wars'' Rewatch: Lessons from Teth in the Theatrical Release (Part 2 of 3)}} {{C|Intel}}</ref>
